acl.usage:
usage:
!owadd <user_id|reply> — grant owner
!owrm <user_id|reply> — revoke owner
!owls — list owners
!sgnew <name> — create a security group
!sgls — list groups
!sg <name> — show group users and rules
!sgdel <name> — delete a group
!sgadd <name> <user_id|reply> — add a user to a group
!sgrm <name> <user_id|reply> — remove a user from a group
!rule <user|chat|sgroup> <target> <command|module>/<name> [expiry] — add a rule
!rulerm — remove a rule
!ruleclr — clear rules for a target
!perm <user_id> <admin|trusted|everyone> [remove] — grant/revoke a permission
!perms — list permissions
!whois <user_id> — user permissions

capability_details.mt: full userbot MTProto access (messages, media, dialogs, chats, channels, contacts) with account security and payment operations blocked
capability_details.files: read and write files inside the module workspace
capability_details.net: outbound HTTP(S) requests to the internet; private/internal targets and denied hosts are blocked
capability_details.state: persistent key-value state in the module namespace
capability_details.inline: query and interact with inline bots
capability_details.modules: load, unload, reload, list, and inspect installed modules; hashes and manifest info
capability_details.shell: full shell access with the Hotaru process OS permissions, including host files, credentials and network; NOT confined to the module workspace. Command timeout and returned output limits still apply
capability_details.logs: write structured entries to the observatory log; always granted
capability_details.fetch: read-only access to messages, entities and reply resolution; always granted
